title: Bug: text object not selectable on stage after deselect
description: After placing text with the Text tool and clicking away to deselect, the text object cannot be re-selected by clicking it on stage. Likely same root cause as symbol-instance selection bug: StageArea click hit-testing filters shapeDisplayObjects for type === 'shape', excluding text objects (type === 'text'). Fix: include text display objects in the single-click hit-test pass alongside shapes.
